title: U.S. and China Reach ‘Framework’ for a TikTok Sale
summary: Top economic officials met in Madrid for a second day, with deadlines looming on tariffs and a ban on TikTok in the United States if it is not sold by its Chinese owner, ByteDance.

title: U.S. and China Resume Talks on Tariffs and TikTok
